dish.title: New Mexican Carne Adovada with Warm Flour Tortillas
dish.description: Cubes of pork shoulder slowly braised in the oven in a brick-red sauce of dried New Mexico red chiles, garlic, oregano, cumin, and a splash of vinegar until spoon-tender. Served with warm flour tortillas, shredded cabbage, and lime.

recipe_version.title: New Mexican Carne Adovada with Warm Flour Tortillas
recipe_version.description: Cubes of pork shoulder slowly braised in the oven in a brick-red sauce of dried New Mexico red chiles, garlic, oregano, cumin, and a splash of vinegar until spoon-tender. Served with warm flour tortillas, shredded cabbage, and lime.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for soaking and blending the chiles

ingredients.name: flour tortillas
ingredients.display_name: 8-inch flour tortillas whose label lists wheat flour, water, oil, salt, and leavening only

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Stem and seed the chiles. Trim and cube the pork and season with 1 tsp salt. Shred the cabbage, chop the cilantro, and cut the limes into wedges.

steps.title: Soak the chiles
steps.body: Bring the chiles and 3 cups water to a simmer in a 2-quart saucepan over medium, then turn off the heat and soak until soft, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Preheat and blend the sauce
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 325 F. Blend the chiles and their soaking liquid with the garlic, oregano, cumin, vinegar, and 1 1/2 tsp salt until very smooth, about 2 minutes. Strain into the Dutch oven, pressing on the solids.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Stir the pork into the sauce in the 5-quart Dutch oven and bring to a simmer on the stovetop over medium.

steps.title: Braise
steps.body: Cover and braise in the oven until the pork falls apart under a spoon, about 2 1/2 hours, stirring once halfway and uncovering for the last 15 minutes to thicken the sauce.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.body: During the last minutes of the braise, warm the tortillas one at a time in a dry 10-inch skillet over medium, about 20 seconds per side, and stack them in a towel (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon the carne adovada into bowls and serve with the tortillas, shredded cabbage, cilantro, and lime wedges.
